title: Noon: Panera opens in South Euclid
description: First 500 customers at South Euclid Panera get free perks

asr.full_text: Thank you Jason. Well a grand opening celebration going on right now in South. Euclid complete with free coffee. A new Panera store opened today on Cedar Road. The first 500 customers got a free travel mug with free coffee for the free. Coffee for the next two weeks. The new store is also offering half-price items. The rest of the week there in South Euclid at the new Panera.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as local news coverage of a Panera store opening, including free items and limited-time discounts as ordinary retail promotions. The on-screen lower-third and store footage frame the customer benefits as a grand-opening promotion, and the separate Burger King promotion does not establish a connection to the Panera report or any deceptive mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The observed content centers on ordinary promotional benefits: free items and coffee tied to a store opening, along with half-price items. No external claim, verification flow, task, payment-for-access mechanism or sensitive-data request is evidenced.
